personality_one_liner: A high-octane, neon-drenched rhythm experience that feels like a live arcade machine.

spacing.rule: Use tight margins for tactical game UI; allow breathing room around primary touch targets. Gameplay HUD must hug edges.

do's: Use heavy tinted glass over neon backgrounds for popups (Profile, Settings, Shop).
Frosted overlays for pause menus and end-screen backing.
dont's: No glass on active gameplay lane or HUD text; causes latency and contrast drops.

screens.name: Home

states.error: Offline mode indicator; local songs only.

screens.layout: Top-bar: Player Level/XP Badge (Cyan) and Starlites (Lime). Center: Massive 50% screen height carousel for 'Quick Play' songs with album art and glowing borders. Bottom: Grid of sharp, neon-bordered angled buttons navigating to Library, Editor, Shop, Settings.

screens.name: Gameplay
screens.layout: 4 perspective lanes converging at top center. Hit line at bottom 20% with glowing strike zones. Left edge: Vertical 'Vocopulse' (fever) meter. Top Center: Massive Score and Combo (Orbitron). Judgments pop up directly over the hit line.

screens.name: Results
screens.layout: Top half: Giant floating Grade letter (S/A/B/C/D) glowing in brand color. 'Full Combo' badge if applicable. Middle: 2x2 grid of judgments (Perfect+, Perfect, Great, Miss) and Max Combo. Bottom: XP bar filling up, Starlites earned, and glowing pill buttons for Retry/Home.

screens.name: Library

states.empty: No custom songs imported. Play default tracks.

screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row has album art (left), title/artist (middle), best grade and mastery crowns (right). Tapping expands row downwards showing difficulty tabs (Easy, Normal, Hard, Vocotap) to launch the game.

instructions_to_main_agent: NEON BUTTONS: Use 'sm' (sharp) radius. Base state: transparent background, 1.5pt border in brandPrimary, text brandPrimary. Active/Pressed state: fill background with brandPrimary, text black (onBrandPrimary).

GAMEPLAY HUD: Cap font weights at 500 for Orbitron. Scale massive for Score/Combo but keep it crisp. Judgments use specific colors: Perfect+ (brandTertiary), Perfect (brandPrimary), Great (brandSecondary), Miss (error).

GLOW EFFECTS: Use react-native-reanimated for pulsing opacity on borders, or drop shadows with brand colors at 0.3-0.5 opacity (blur radius 10-20) to simulate neon glow around buttons and grade letters.
HAPTICS: Must map heavy haptics to MISS, light haptics to PERFECT+, and continuous subtle haptics while holding 'wavy notes'.
RESULTS SCREEN: Use expo-blur over 'background_neon_abstract' to create a deep, layered arcade feel before showing the giant Grade letter.
